name: @fathyshalaby/receipts
description: Make a coding agent leave receipts: a recorded visual-QA walkthrough + the reasoning behind every PR, packaged as one self-contained artefact a human can judge in 90 seconds.
author: Fathy Shalaby (https://github.com/fathyshalaby)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.demo: tsx receipts/scripts/cli.ts qa --input examples/receipt-input.json --no-judge && tsx receipts/scripts/cli.ts build --in .receipts/demo-task-list && tsx receipts/scripts/cli.ts open --in .receipts/demo-task-list
